articles.title: University of Kansas Kicks Off Football Season with Huge Stadium Improvements Including New Daktronics Video Display

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, announces the expanded capabilities of All Sport Pro to include integration with fixed-digit scoreboards. Previously, All Sport consoles were the go-to option for control of non-video scoreboards, but this expansion of All Sport Pro levels the playing field for scoreboard control.
articles.title: Daktronics Introduces All Sport Pro for Fixed-Digit Scoreboards

articles.title: Eye On Crime Increases with Daktronics, High Point Networks Collaboration for Pueblo Police Department’s Real-Time Crime Center
